subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should Feishu outbound hook parity be fixed separately from normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening, and which canonical outbound-hook PR should own the Feishu acceptance criteria?
rationale: The remaining outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but changing normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics affects plugin claim authority, ordering, and security boundaries that automation should not choose.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound_claim
options.body: Land or adapt one canonical outbound-hook PR for Feishu configured/prebuilt dispatcher coverage, then track normal-channel `inbound_claim` separately.

options.title: Fold Feishu into the broader outbound tracker
options.body: Move this issue’s Feishu evidence under the configured `beforeDeliver` hook-bypass tracker and leave this issue only for inbound-claim API discussion.

options.title: Solve all requested hooks together
options.body: Use one broader design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound_claim
recommendation.body: Land or adapt one canonical outbound-hook PR for Feishu configured/prebuilt dispatcher coverage, then track normal-channel `inbound_claim` separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to current plugin hook semantics and Feishu delivery history, and is a good routing owner for choosing the hook contract before implementation proceeds.
